# The published distribution with the calendar-adjusted middle band (#418)

<!-- generated: calendar-bands -->

**Generated by `scripts/calendar_bands_418.py render` from `docs/runs/published_distribution_calendar_daily_h1.json`; never hand-edited.**

The middle band of the published distribution (the 25% to 75% range, and the median inside it) was recalibrated: each day's quantiles are shifted by what the recent misses on that kind of day (a turn of the month, quarter or tax date, a coupon settlement, or an ordinary day) say they should have been. The setting is `conformal_pid_calendar`, as declared before it was scored in `docs/declarations/interior_calibration_243_addendum.json` (sha256 `fa8d55a42977`) and unchanged. It met the declared test on 2018-06-29 to 2025-12-31 (#243) and held on 2026-01-02 to 2026-09-03 (#408). **The 90% band is not adjusted**: its edges (the 5% and 95% quantiles) are the published ones. The declared rule sorts each day's vector, so on 60 of 2042 days an adjusted middle value that crossed an edge became the edge: always outward, never inward. The live record and the live pin are untouched.

Gain is CRPS(before) - CRPS(after) per day in bp, so a positive mean favours the adjusted band; intervals are 90% stationary bootstraps (block length 2). Coverage cells: coverage %, then the share of days below / above the band.
